Domain: Mental — Resource: Focus — Specialty: Threads — Specialty Condition: Concentration

Direct shaping, release, alteration, and control of magical forces, leaving behind Threads that can strengthen or alter later spellwork.

Threads

After a Magecraft Action, create the fixed Thread of its subtype (unlike other Riders, Magecraft Thread Riders never vary — every Action of a given subtype always creates the same Thread). Maintain up to 3 Threads; creating a 4th discards one existing Thread. Several Threads may be consumed on one Action when its rules permit. Unused Threads end when the Encounter ends. Ten fixed subtypes in four families: Elemental (Fire, Water, Earth, Air), Cosmic (Time, Space), Perceptual (Light, Shadow), Arcane (Aether, Chaos).

Expertises

  • Channeling
  • Sculpting
  • Fabrication
  • Transmutation
  • Augmentation
  • Reinforcement
  • Disjunction
